policy: Use OpenKO CN3SndMgr/CN3SndObj event paths only; never add parallel DOM audio.

browser_runtime.reason: WS42 browser patch explicitly disables CN3SndMgr::InitOpenAL for single-thread Emscripten because native audio workers require pthreads. P2-10 must not claim sound until P2-00 selects and proves an audio-capable rebuild.
required: fresh P2-00 source rebuild; never reuse C5 binary
one sound-manager lifecycle per client session
mute/BGM/effect volume persistence through native Option state
re-entry test proving no duplicate BGM/ambient instances

events.lifecycle: CreateStreamObj -> Looping(true) -> Play; Stop on battle/zone transition; ReleaseSound on teardown
native stream object, mutually stopped against town BGM

events.source_object: world sound assets from client data
events.lifecycle: native world init/release; ReleaseSound calls ACT_WORLD->GetSkyRef()->ReleaseSound()
do not synthesize from DOM key events; event must remain animation/movement driven
trigger from authoritative/native combat event, not button click success
trigger from native skill execution/result path; failed skill must not emit success sound
UI open/click/error events stay native; no HTML audio mirror

duplicate_prevention: P2-00 must prove ReleaseSound/CN3SndMgr teardown occurs before a new world/client audio lifecycle is created; P2-10 will not add a second browser audio graph.
